prompt: Find the exact value of $\cot 30^\circ$. Write it using "sqrt", for example "sqrt(2)/2".

alternativeExplanations.title: Flip the tangent
steps: That is bigger than $1$, which makes sense: a shallow $30^\circ$ ramp runs much further than it rises.
